mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_audit_logs (operator_id, action, method, path, target, result, status_code, ip, user_agent, detail) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{action}, #{method}, #{path}, #{target}, #{result}, #{statusCode}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{detail})
mapper.select:
SELECT l.*, u.full_name AS operator_name, u.username AS operator_username FROM t_audit_logs l LEFT JOIN t_users u ON u.id = l.operator_id
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_audit_logs l LEFT JOIN t_users u ON u.id = l.operator_id
